<parameter=code>

r = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 44, 'col': 34}, 'LEFT', 'LEFT'])
f = current_frame
for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ('N','W','B') and n['pixels'] <= 40:
        b = n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
        print(n['color'], min(rs), max(rs), min(cs), max(cs), n['pixels'])
print('board_changed:', r.get('board_changed'), 'level:', f.level, 'step:', f.step)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
